summary: Thanks, I fixed it. You get an h-card and webmentions with @blogger but that is more than enough for folks to enjoy the bounty of #IndieWeb, just having a place to call your own is all you need. Everything else just empowers the network.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Thanks, I fixed it. You get an h-card and webmentions with @blogger but that is more than enough for folks to enjoy the bounty of #IndieWeb, just having a place to call your own is all you need. Everything else just empowers the network.
